The '''Harron Marches''' were a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Marches bordered the [[Belasco sector/Legends|Belasco sector]] [[spinward]]. The sector also formed a four-way border with the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian]], [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous]], and [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sectors]] at its southern edge as well as a four-way border with the Askarian, [[Hangshan sector/Legends|Hangshan]], and [[Serathrace sector/Legends|Serathrace sector]] at its western reaches.<ref name="Expansion" /> The Harron Marches contained the [[Bruvia system/Legends|Bruvia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which shared its name with the [[Bruvian]] social group.<ref name="MSI">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Harron Marches were established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares O-11 and P-11.<ref name="Expansion" />
